# Jay Tranberg — Software Engineering Portfolio

> Portfolio of Jay Tranberg, a platform engineer, product architect, and full-stack software developer based in Victoria, British Columbia, Canada.

Jay Tranberg designs and builds production-oriented SaaS platforms, distributed IoT systems, AI applications, operational dashboards, API integrations, and real-time software.

## Portfolio

- [Software Engineering Portfolio](https://jaytranberg.com.com/)
  Overview of selected software, SaaS, AI, IoT, mobile, and Web3 projects.

## Featured Projects

- [Project Falcon Telemetry Dashboard](https://project-falcon-iot.netlify.app/)
  Distributed IoT drone telemetry platform using C++, MQTT, Node.js, gRPC, MongoDB, Socket.IO, Docker, and React.

- [Project Falcon Drone Console](https://drone-console.netlify.app/)
  Real-time aircraft command interface for mission control, altitude, heading, hover, return-to-home, and landing operations.

- [United Sports Prospects](https://unitedsportsprospects.com/)
  Athlete intelligence and scouting platform supporting prospect discovery, player research, recruiting analysis, and large-scale sports data.

- [Fan7](https://fan7.netlify.app/)
  AI-native customer experience and operational platform for automotive service businesses.

- [Observation Lounge](https://the-observation-lounge.netlify.app/)
  Operational intelligence platform for monitoring application health, incidents, response times, and production systems.

- [Black T-Shirt Catalog API](https://catalog.blktshirt.ca/)
  Large-scale product catalog API and branded commerce interface supporting more than 220,000 items.

## Engineering Capabilities

- Full-stack application architecture

- gRPC and microservices
- Socket.IO and real-time communication
- REST APIs and third-party integrations
- Dockerized development environments
- AI integration and intelligent workflows
- Authentication and role-based authorization
- Monitoring and operational intelligence

## About

Jay Tranberg builds complete software products from architecture and backend services through user interfaces, infrastructure, deployment, and operational monitoring.
